For Alt_r^+, the coefficient of x_i counts alternating index-chains starting at i; this count is strictly decreasing in i because the first step is a strict ascent. Complementing each intermediate index gives a bijection showing that the Alt_r^- coefficients are the reverse of the Alt_r^+ coefficients. Pairing symmetric indices then yields the required sign of the difference for monotone x, with strictness for nonconstant x.
